steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the requested RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured event.
Verify that the event reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal while keeping the buyer session.
Open the event's Technical stage first to verify stage-specific terms do not appear there.
The required RFQ clause must not appear on the Technical stage.
The optional RFQ clause must not appear on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses should apply.
Verify the required clause is shown to the vendor on the RFQ stage.
Verify the optional clause is shown on the RFQ stage.
Accept only the required clause.
Leave the optional clause unaccepted.
Submit the RFQ quote with the required clause accepted and the optional clause unaccepted.
Verify that the vendor's RFQ bid was submitted successfully despite the optional clause remaining unaccepted.
